newsitem.title: BRAZIL: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BRAZIL, March 18 - Vitoria - Seven vessels berthed of which 2 bulk wheat dischargers, 1 bulk malt discharger, 1 granite loader, 1 vehicle discharger, 1 vehicle/container discharger, 1 pig-iron loader. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders, 1 petroleum discharger. Praia Mole - 3 Steel products loaders, 2 coal dischargers. Portocel, Ubu - No vessels, 18 waiting in roads. Santos - 19 Vessels berthed of which 1 diesel oil loader, 3 full container loader/dischargers, 2 bulk cement dischargers, 1 bulk chemical products loader/discharger, 1 sulphur discharger, 2 bulk wheat dischargers, 3 general cargo/container loader/dischargers, 1 salt discharger, 1 general cargo discharger, 2 general cargo loader/dischargers, 2 soya loaders. 6 Vessels waiting in roads, 61 due over the next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 2 Steel products loaders, 1 bulk coal discharger, 1 iron ore. Ultrafertil - No vessels. Paranagua - 11 Vessels berthed of which 2 general cargo dischargers, 1 reefer discharger, 1 fertiliser, 2 pellets loaders, 2 soya loaders, 2 general cargo loaders, 1 reefer loader. 28 Vessels waiting in roads of which to load, 9 pellets, 1 general cargo, 6 soy. To discharge, 1 fertiliser, 1 containers. 28 Vessels due over the next 7 days. Rio Grande - Seven vessels berthed of which 4 full containers, 1 fertiliser discharger, 1 fuel discharger, 1 wheat loader. No vessels waiting in roads, 16 due over the next 10 days.

Rio de Janeiro - 10 Vessels berthed of which 1 general cargo/steel products discharger, 1 wheat discharger, 1 steel products discharger, 2 general cargo/container dischargers, 1 passenger vessel, 2 paper dischargers, 1 oil discharger, 1 sugar loader. Tecon - 3 Vessels. 14 Vessels due over the next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 2 Vessels berthed. Commercial quay - No vessels. 2 Waiting in roads, 9 due over the next 7 days.

CHILE, March 17 - Arica - No vessels at terminal, 6 berths vacant, 6 vessels due during the week. Iquique - Three vessels berthed and operating, 4 berths vacant, 16 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Six vessels berthed, 1 berth vacant, 16 vessels due during the week to load,discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Seven vessels berthed and operating, 1 berth vacant. Pier 3 out of service for enlargement until April. 35 Vessels due during the week with 1 days delay expected. San Anton - Seven vessels operating, 1 berth vacant. 17 Vessels due during the week, port busy, but no waiting.

Puerto Montt - One vessel in port operating, 1 berth vacant. 6 Vessels and 1 passenger vessel due during the week. Punta Arenas - Two vessels berthed, 15 due during the week. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed and operating, 4 due this week, no vessels in roads. San Vicente - Two vessels berthed and operating, 4 due during the week with 1 day berthing delay expected. Navy pier (Molo 500) - 2 Vessels berthed, 3 due during the week. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed. Coronel pier - No vessels at terminal. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel. Lirquen - One vessel berthed, 5 berths vacant, 4 vessels due during the week.

COLOMBIA, March 18 - Barranquilla - Seven vessels berthed of which 3 bulkers, 1 containers, 3 general cargo. 14 Vessels due of which 3 bulkers, 6 containers, 5 general cargo, no waiting time. Cartagena - Three vessels berthed of which 2 containers, 1 passenger vessel. 17 Vessels due of which 1 bulker, 10 containers, 4 general cargo, 2 passenger vessels, no waiting time. Santa Marta - Four vessels berthed of which 1 bulker, 3 containers. 14 Vessels due of which 2 bulkers, 5 containers, 7 general cargo, no waiting time. Buenaventura - Seven vessels berthed of which 3 bulkers, 4 containers. 6 Vessels anchored of which 5 bulkers, 1 containers. 27 Vessels due of which 4 bulkers, 16 containers, 2 tankers, 4 general cargo, 1 pcc. 3 Days waiting time expected for bulkers.

PERU, March 17 - No strikes at any port. Callao - Two vessels anchored, 3 general cargo/container vessels in port, no berthing delays. Paita, Bayovar, Pisco, Ilo - No vessels, no delays. Talara - Three vessels anchored, 2 berthed, 1 day berthing delay expected. Chimbote - One vessel anchored, 2 fish meal vessels berthed, no berthing delays.
